title: KCP lens_read result (DESIGN.md §10.2, §11.6.1 read family)
description: CommandResult.result payload for lens_read (§11.2 ok arm; the envelope's revision/event_cursor members live outside this payload). §11.5 page of lens presentation items (open item shape, gap note KG25) (gap notes KG4/KG9). §11.5 page shape verbatim: { items[], next?, snapshot, boundary_event_cursor }. The first page creates a stable snapshot token (expiry >= 15 minutes); further pages see the same logical boundary or return snapshot-expired; authorization is rechecked for every page (gap note KG9).

items.description: Lens presentation projection over authorized canonical records; the item shape is the lens's declarative presentation and is not pinned in this slice (gap note KG25). Projections cannot add objects that fail ordinary authorization (§10.2).
Page of lens presentation items; at most 512 items (§11.8 page read limit); every item passes ordinary authorization item-by-item (§10.4).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).
